user.title: Solar Energy Insights
user.description: Pick the battery, the house's energy counter and Solcast. With EF-PowerOcean-TcpModbus and Solcast installed they are filled in.

data_description.battery_capacity: In Wh or kWh. While it reports none, the last value is used.
data_description.battery_reserve: The reserve in force, in %. For EF-PowerOcean-TcpModbus: Effective Battery Reserve.
data_description.house_energy: A counter of energy the house used, daily or lifetime. Its recorded hours are what the night is replayed from.
data_description.grid_power: Optional: shows when a full battery is exporting (free power).
data_description.solcast_today: The Solcast sensor for today, with its detailedForecast attribute.

data_description.min_reserve: The lowest the inverter discharges to by itself, under any reserve.

data_description.round_trip: Share of stored energy that comes back out.

data_description.price: What a kWh bought costs, in cents.
data_description.feed_in: What a kWh exported earns, in cents.
data_description.price_entity: For a dynamic tariff: overrides the electricity price while it has a value. Its current value applies to every hour ahead; nothing is timed to cheap hours. Read as cents if its unit starts with ct, else as your currency per kWh.
